Image 1 is the last accepted full screenshot, before the action. Image 2 is the current candidate full screenshot. The action below was dispatched once. It is not a claim of successful execution. Question 0:
Does Image 2 visibly reflect an outcome of the dispatched action relative to Image 1? Use the part of the interface affected by the action. Ignore unrelated visual changes. Neither identical pixels nor different pixels alone establish the outcome. Do not infer a hidden state, successful task completion, or when either capture occurred.
Options:
A: YES: The relevant UI visibly shows an outcome of the action, including an explicit failure response. Also choose YES for a visibly supported no-op, for example scrolling further at a clearly shown boundary.
B: NO: The relevant result is still pending, the relevant UI still appears to be in the earlier state, or the two screenshots do not establish an outcome. If unsure, choose NO.
